groups.title: From source code to a process

demos.title: Follow two C files through the build
demos.summary: Preprocess, compile, assemble, link, load, and run.
demos.observe: Follow greet from its declaration to its definition and the linked call. The generated files are in steps/.

demos.title: Find defined and undefined symbols
demos.summary: Compare a global variable and a library call before and after linking.
demos.observe: counter is a defined global; puts remains a dynamic-library symbol in the executable.

demos.title: Compare link-time values and run-time addresses
demos.summary: Run the same executable twice and compare its addresses with nm.
demos.observe: With PIE and ASLR, run-time addresses can change while symbol values in the executable stay fixed.

demos.title: Compare memory access and system-call costs
demos.summary: Time small and large pointer chains and a getpid system call.
demos.observe: Compare the three costs on this VM. The program needs about 1 GiB of free memory; timings vary.

demos.summary: Check protection before relocation; compare the last legal address with the first illegal one.
Compare fit policies, then expose and remove external fragmentation.
Split, look up, and join an address while keeping the offset unchanged.
Trace hits, misses, FIFO replacement, and process tags.
Observe real Linux page permissions and child-process fault reports.
Follow two page-table indexes and compare sparse-table storage.

guides.title: Build and run
guides.markdown: From chap09_memory_management, run `make` to build the C demos and `make check` to check the six memory walkthroughs. Run each command from the folder containing its source file. Add `--step` to a new walkthrough to pause before each result.

guides.title: Models and Linux behavior
guides.markdown: Base/limit, allocation, translation, TLB, and two-level page tables are textbook simulations. The page-protection demo uses real Linux mappings. Simulated addresses and access times do not describe the VM hardware. The older Manim visual aids are separate from this C demo sequence.
